content: Much of the available macroeconomic and market literature tends to prioritize forward-looking projections or aggregated stock market trends over retrospective, industry-specific market share metrics. For example, the J.P. Morgan Mid-Year Outlook 2026 primarily provides forward-looking assessments focused on Business Development Companies and valuation metrics for 2026, without exploring historical industry market shares for South Africa during the 2020-2023 timeframe [1] . Furthermore, while datasets from FRED highlight historical trends in South Africa’s share price indices spanning from 1960 to the first quarter of 2026, their aggregated nature restricts their applicability for detailed market share analysis, as they reflect general market trends rather than specific industrial breakdowns [4] . The JSE website, despite being a primary authority for South African exchange data, similarly emphasizes current market data and forward-looking resources, making it difficult to access archival reports tailored to specific sectoral breakdowns for the 2020-2023 period [5] .
